notes.title: Fixed startup crash
notes.content: Fixed a crash caused by [i]something[/i] setting the width of the window to a random, very high number.

notes.title: Bigger viewports
notes.content:
I've added an option to increase the viewport sizes. You can change the sizes in the pause menu. I've also added an option to toggle the singleplayer view to the pause menu, in case you forget which button to press.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155367/7bc511544af0c3abda9d10a82edc76db3f2bcddd.jpg[/img]
